entry_state: The literature supplies accounting algebra,incomplete-data semantics,provenance,inference,language and extraction components with explicit transfer limits. It leaves their integration and empirical merit unresolved. The architecture chapter must assign reusable components and project-specific responsibilities while keeping a typed-library alternative viable.
exit_state: A shared typed representation now connects multiple authoring paths to explicit contract,valuation and solver adapters. The Python reference path remains the baseline,and accounting recognition stays in AccDSL. The next chapter must define compatible histories,valid transitions and conditional results mathematically.
findings: The architecture diagram is legible and follows the evidence-to-history-to-events-to-statements argument. An assumed60/40 debt split does not become a reported fact.
The alternatives table treats typed Python as capable of the whole product and keeps the textual frontend reversible. Shared conformance cases precede performance claims.

The software table records bounded inspection,candidate roles and license metadata without claiming integration or blanket redistribution clearance. Contract/valuation adapters cannot post directly,and solver scope remains explicit. No confirmed new defect.
